proposals.before: Book of Sui, 43th year of Volume, eighth year of Biographies
proposals.reason: Idiomatic English garbles volume/biography numbering as years.

proposals.before: Hejian Wang Hong, styled Bie'e, was a younger male cousin of Emperor Gaozu's father.
proposals.after: Hejian Wang Hong, styled Bie'e, was a younger paternal-line cousin of Gaozu.
proposals.reason: 從祖弟 means a same-generation junior cousin of Gaozu, not a cousin of Gaozu's father.

proposals.before: sixth year of In of Daye (610), he was posthumously created Prince of Xun.
proposals.after: In the sixth year of Daye (610), he was posthumously created Prince of Xun.

proposals.before: When the emperor visited the Yunyang Palace, Prince Zhi of Wei rebelled and led his followers in an assault on the Su Zang Gate; Xiong met the attack and routed them.
proposals.after: When the emperor visited the Yunyang Palace, Prince Zhi of Wei rebelled and led his followers in an assault on the Suzhang Gate; Xiong met the attack and routed them.
proposals.reason: 肅章門 is Suzhang Gate; "Su Zang" is a corrupted transcription.

decisions.reason: 卷四十三列傳第八 is Volume 43, Biographies 8; the idiomatic wrongly reads 卷/第 as 'year' and invents dating the Chinese does not support.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 隋書卷四十三列傳第八

decisions.reason: 高祖從祖弟也 makes Hong Gaozu's junior paternal-line cousin (從祖弟), not a cousin of Gaozu's father; the proposed literal restores that kinship.
大業六年 is the sixth year of Daye; 'In of Daye' is a garbled reign title and the proposed fix matches the Chinese.
肅章門 is the Suzhang Gate; 'Su Zang' is a corrupted transcription, and the proposed idiomatic wording corrects the gate name without changing the rest of the sentence.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0004 restores Suzhang for 肅章門; the event-participation action's 'Su Zang Gate' spelling came only from the bad idiomatic.
